properties.value: Non-security-purpose PRNG use; the security-sensitive randomness in this SDK (STARK-curve keygen) goes through crypto/rand (see ALG-80605930). Go rejects unused imports, so all three imports are live uses.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: STARK-curve ECDSA keygen and signing — the signature scheme that authorizes every StarkNet account transaction this SDK sends. Quantum-unsafe (Shor breaks the EC discrete log). Algorithm fixed by the StarkNet protocol (on-chain account contracts verify ECDSA on the STARK curve): observable here, replaceable only by the protocol; SDK-side migration target is an ML-DSA-65 equivalent once the protocol moves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: STARK-curve ECDSA keygen/sign/verify; consumed by account/signature.go (Account.Sign → keystore Sign → curve.Sign) for invoke/declare/deploy-account transaction signatures, verified on-chain by the account contract. Quantum-unsafe signature primitive on a deadline (not harvest) timeline; algorithm fixed by the StarkNet protocol.
